name: ErrorPage
title: Blocks/State/ErrorPage
summary: The error page of Azion's own surfaces (Console, the site, the docs) when a page cannot show what the user asked for. Quiet and traceable: one centred `EmptyState` column with the HTTP code as a `StatusCode` in its figure, a title in plain words, one sentence, at most two `Button`s, and a reference line with the error code, the request ID (with `CopyButton`) and the time (`Timestamp`, UTC) for support. A visually hidden h1 names the code. The primary is the 404 (Go to home and Docs); variants cover 401 (session expired, Sign in), 403 (Request access, Switch account), 429 (Try again, About rate limits), 500 (Retry, System status), 503 (scheduled maintenance) and a missing record inside the console (Back to services). A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout (or the site and docs shells); the 401 renders signed out, without the rail. The pages Azion's edge serves to visitors of customer sites use `state/edge-error-page` instead.

variants.name: SessionExpired
variants.summary: 401: the session ended. Your session expired, why (signed out after 12 hours for security), and Sign in, which brings the user back to the same address. Rendered signed out, without the console rail.

variants.name: Forbidden
variants.summary: 403: the address exists but the user's role does not include it. You don't have access to this page, who can grant it, and Request access with Switch account.

variants.name: RateLimited
variants.summary: 429: the account sent more requests than the limit allows. Too many requests, nothing was lost, and Try again with About rate limits.

variants.name: ServerError
variants.summary: 500: the page failed on the server. Something went wrong on our side, nothing saved was lost, Retry (which shows its loading state while the page reloads) and System status in a new tab.

variants.name: Maintenance
variants.summary: 503: scheduled maintenance. Back soon, until when, that the applications keep serving traffic, and Retry with Status page.

variants.name: ResourceNotFound
variants.summary: Inside the console: the route is valid but the record is not (deleted, or a stale link). The 404 names the resource and its ID and offers Back to services.
